snippet.title: Golden Axe III - Full Co-op Gameplay - Hard Diff. GOOD ENDING (No Death) Sega Genesis/Mega Drive
snippet.description:
Damud Hellbringer, the Prince of Darkness, has taken away the Golden Axe and put an evil curse over all the warriors. However, one of the heroes has their curse relieved and is sent to set things straight - lift the curse off the others, defeat the villain and return with the Golden Axe.

🔵Subscribe: https://bit.ly/OverallGames

Platform(s): Sega Genesis / Mega Drive
Release: June 25, 1993
Developer: Sega Enterprises
Genre(s): Adventure, Beat 'em Up, Action
Mode(s):1-2 Players
Publisher(s): Sega Enterprises , Sega of America
